approximation_notice: Each recording is only an approximation to an emitted source waveform. It already contains the original microphone response, recording environment, background sound and source motion; normalized re-propagation cannot establish absolute SPL or detection range.

independent_split_protocol.independence_rule: A split is independent only when calibration and evaluation each contain at least two unique recording_id, session_id and origin_asset_id values, with no session_id or origin_asset_id shared across splits. Files, fragments and transcodes sharing a session or origin asset count once.
